test_playthrough: test the generate_playthrough.playthrough function to generate a playthrough text for tic_tac_toe with a given action sequence
test_format_tensor: test the generate_playthrough._format_tensor function to format 1d, 2d, and 3d numpy arrays as readable text with ◉ and ◉ symbols
test_format_tensor_linewrap: test the generate_playthrough._format_tensor function with max_cols parameter to wrap 3d tensor output across multiple lines
test_should_display_state_tracker: test the ShouldDisplayStateTracker class to determine which game states are interesting enough to display during a playthrough
test_playthrough_lines: test the generate_playthrough.playthrough_lines function to return a playthrough of a game as a list of formatted text lines
